events.title: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
events.description: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
events.ticker_label: 🌪️ Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China

Paris Saint-Germain, Barcelona and Arsenal also opened their campaigns with victories as the tournament's leading clubs got off the mark.

events.title: Trump 'believes in the power of his own charisma', analyst says
events.description: Republicans opened their highly unusual midterm convention in Dallas on Wednesday afternoon, a “Trump-a-Palooza” that is putting the president at the center of this fall’s midterm elections — whether the candidates running like it or not. Speaking with FRANCE 24's Sharon Gaffney, Professor Todd Belt, Director of the Political Management Programme at George Washington University, says that Trump "believes in the power of his own charisma".

events.title: Apple launches first foldable iPhone
events.description: Apple has unveiled its first foldable iPhone at the company's annual launch event in California.

events.title: Container ship arrives in UK after landmark voyage from China via the Arctic
events.description: A container ship has arrived in the UK after a landmark journey from China via ‌the Arctic, as part of plans for more ​vessels to use the route as a shorter and potentially safer ​alternative to the Suez ‌Canal.

events.title: More than 10% chance AI 'could kill all humans' - as Anthropic reveals another 'cybersecurity' incident
events.description: There is a more than 10% chance that "AI could kill all humans" in the next decade, according to a top safety researcher at Anthropic.

events.title: Airbnb faces potential new restrictions as EU proposes clampdown on holiday rentals
events.description: The EU has drafted new rules which could lead to more restrictions for Airbnb and other short-term home rental companies.

events.title: Prince of Wales joins mourners at funeral of Norway's King Harald
events.description: The Prince of Wales ​and Princess Anne have joined other royals and European leaders at the funeral of King Harald V of Norway.

events.title: Breakaway league LIV Golf files for bankruptcy protection
events.description: Professional men's golf league LIV Golf has filed for bankruptcy protection in the US.

events.title: China says it hopes to agree with US on tariff reductions 'at an early date'
events.description: A Chinese government spokesperson says China and the U.S. hope to reach an agreement on lowering import taxes soon

events.title: S. Korea trying to learn if Kim Jong Un has a son but daughter's status appears solid
events.description: South Korea’s spy agency says it is trying to determine if North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has a son

events.title: Zelenskyy visits Canada to seek further military support for Ukraine
events.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is in Canada for talks with Prime Minister Mark Carney

events.title: Flight carrying Zelenskyy to Norway was delayed in Moldova because of drone incursion
events.description: A Moldovan government spokesman says a flight scheduled to carry Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy from Moldova to Norway was delayed when authorities closed Moldova’s airspace because of a drone incursion

events.title: Stronger-than-normal El Nino alarms scientists over Galápagos wildlife and forests
events.description: The prediction that this season’s El Nino will be stronger than normal has alarmed the Ecuadorian scientific community

events.title: Journalist named king of Ugandan monarchy that just lost its onetime 'boy king'
events.description: A news anchor has been unexpectedly named the next monarch of Uganda's Tooro Kingdom

events.title: Israel opens embassy in Slovenia as small EU nation shifts policies
events.description: Israel has opened its embassy in Slovenia, boosting relations with the small European Union nation as ties soured with the United Kingdom and some of the other longtime allies

events.title: UK government defends decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements
events.description: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband has defended the decision to ban trade with Israeli settlements in the West Bank

events.title: Ebola response in eastern DR Congo must include food assistance, WFP says
events.description: As Ebola sweeps across the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), ensuring families meet their basic food needs is crucial to halt the spread of the deadly disease.

events.title: Syria’s transition hinges on justice for all, UN Human Rights Council hears
events.description: A successful and lasting transition in Syria requires comprehensive accountability, inclusion and guarantees that violations will not be repeated, UN independent investigators told the Human Rights Council in Geneva on Tuesday.

events.title: Charlie Kirk assassination: New UVU president says it will continue to 'host the frays,' embrace free speech
events.description: UVU's new president revealed his two daughters were just yards from Charlie Kirk's assassination and vowed to continue fostering free speech on campus.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer reveals post-mistrial strategy as retrial looms
events.description: Lindsay Clancy's attorney Kevin Reddington reveals his strategy after the mistrial, urging prosecutors to pursue treatment instead of prison while appealing to President Donald Trump.

events.title: Surrogate who refused abortion takes fight to Supreme Court as baby's life hangs in balance
events.description: Surrogate McKenna West asks the Supreme Court to block a California ruling that left her unable to advocate for a newborn with a rare heart defect.

events.title: Manhattan prostitute pleads guilty to killing 3 men with fentanyl-laced drugs in robbery scheme
events.description: Tabitha Bundrick admitted to feeding fentanyl-laced drugs to three men during encounters across Manhattan, then robbing them as they lay unconscious.

events.title: Lindsay Clancy juror who backed the defense also publicly cheered Karen Read's acquittal
events.description: A juror in the Lindsay Clancy mistrial previously voiced support for Karen Read online. A mistrial was declared in Clancy's case after jurors could not reach a verdict.

events.title: Accused wife killer Barry Morphew back behind bars after separate incident that skyrocketed bond: prosecutors
events.description: Barry Morphew's bond jumped to $10 million cash after prosecutors alleged a hit-and-run incident and argued the accused wife killer is a flight risk.

events.title: GOP puts Trump ‘on the ballot’ with historic midterm convention and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Philippines defense chief calls out China after note interrupts remarks at Seoul forum: 'Coercion, bullying'
events.description: Gilberto Teodoro read aloud a note from China handed to him mid-speech at the Seoul Defense Dialogue, calling it actual coercion and bullying.

events.title: Art heist thieves make off with Renoir paintings worth millions from museum on French Riviera
events.description: Two thieves cut through a fence at the French Riviera's Renoir Museum in Cagnes-sur-Mer, stealing four paintings but dropping two as police closed in.

events.title: UN agency accused of Hamas ties sees another European nation cut funding
events.description: Finland will discontinue UNRWA funding by end of 2026, following the Trump administration and Sweden in cutting ties with the Hamas-linked U.N. agency.

events.title: Rome ramps up security around Colosseum with new ‘red zone’ targeting criminals
events.description: Rome's new red zone around the Colosseum targets predatory crime and disorder after a violent July 1 confrontation involving roughly 50 people.
